report_name: Google Fined €403M by Irish DPC for GDPR Location Data Violations

identities.name: Google Ireland Limited
identities.description: Google's main establishment in the European Union for data processing purposes, fined €403 million by the Irish DPC for GDPR violations related to the processing of user location data between 2018 and 2020.

identities.name: Irish Data Protection Commission
identities.description: Ireland's Data Protection Commission (DPC), which acted as the lead EU regulator in a multi-year investigation into Google's location data practices, ultimately imposing a €403 million fine for GDPR breaches.

identities.name: European Data Protection Board
identities.description: The European regulatory body that confirmed the Irish DPC's decision to fine Google for GDPR violations.
